a.title: Leaked IPO docs: Anthropic tempts investors with existential risk warning

b.lede: Reported admission to investors of AI’s ‘self-preserving behaviours’ comes as company prepares for a potential $2tn flotation Anthropic is telling investors that advanced AI could pose “catastrophic or existential risks to humanity”, according to reports, as it prepares for a potential $2tn (£1.5tn) flotation. The warning inside the startup’s IPO prospectus, which has yet to be made public, was reported
b.title: Anthropic ‘warns of existential AI risks to humanity’ in IPO document
